answer_sql:
SELECT
  ROUND(SUM(s.net_amount), 2) AS net_revenue
FROM contoso_served.v_contoso5_sales_line AS s
JOIN contoso_served.dim_product AS p
  ON s.product_key = p.product_key
WHERE
  p.brand = $brand

body.value: 38,431,107.32 US dollars — what customers were actually charged, after discount, for Contoso-branded goods across every sale this warehouse records. Behind the figure: 59,896 sales lines on 45,125 orders over 710 Contoso products, first order 2016-05-18, last order 2025-12-31. Dated by when orders were PLACED, not delivered.

SELECT
  p.brand,
  p.manufacturer,
  COUNT(*) AS lines,
  COUNT(DISTINCT p.product_key) AS products,
  SUM(s.net_amount) AS net_revenue
FROM contoso_served.v_contoso5_sales_line AS s

WHERE
  p.brand ILIKE '%contoso%' OR p.manufacturer ILIKE '%contoso%'
GROUP BY
  1,
  2
ORDER BY
